provenance: Approximate shell mask derived from author-supplied reference; realtime core/volume/glow/motes reconstructed.

animation.shell: 20 shape frames with signed-distance interpolation; no optical-flow texture
animation.volume: analytic sphere falloff + continuously orbiting cyan lobes
animation.glow: analytic radial additive light, independent intensity
animation.motes: deterministic short-life native-style line particles; no frame textures
animation.clock: per-instance seconds; frame phase = age * 41.66666666666667; loop 0.48 seconds
animation.interpolationLimit: Distance interpolation removes hold steps/alpha double-images but is not optical flow; fast topology changes may still contract.

separationLimit: Threshold/component approximation; connected jagged tips remain with shell. Not original artist layers or pixel-identical reconstruction.

resources.note: R8 capacity only; actual Unity format/platform memory and GPU sampling cost untested. RGBA fallback has no raw-memory saving.
